600871.SS.longBusinessSummary: Sinopec Oilfield Service Corporation provides integrated petroleum engineering and oilfield technical services in China and internationally. The company was formerly known as Sinopec Yizheng Chemical Fibre Company Limited and changed its name to Sinopec Oilfield Service Corporation in March 2015. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China. Sinopec Oilfield Service Corporation is a subsidiary of China Petrochemical Corporation.
